description: Client-side script for the 'Assessment Result Tool' form in ERPNext, handling assessment data fetching, rendering, scoring, and submission.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, setting fetch options.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, sets values based on route options.
